synopsis: The glossary identifies gRPC as a network protocol for calls between programs and says RoadRunner uses it [f16237]. Chapter 11 corroborates this, listing gRPC among MathWorks stack interfaces and explicitly among RoadRunner Scenario interfaces alongside OpenSCENARIO and MATLAB [f8383, f8961, f9195]. The supplied facts establish interface availability but provide no gRPC-specific performance, cost, version, or integration requirements [f8383, f16237, f8961, f9195].

relations.note: Restate the MathWorks interface list, with additional formats and partner detail in f8383.
Both identify gRPC as an interface used by RoadRunner.
Specifies RoadRunner Scenario and its accompanying OpenSCENARIO and MATLAB interfaces.
Explains gRPC's role as a network protocol and identifies RoadRunner as its user.
